whyStudy.title: Academic Prestige & Global Prestige
whyStudy.desc: American degrees are universally respected by Fortune 500 employers, academic institutions, and global tech leaders.

whyStudy.title: 3-Year STEM OPT Extension
whyStudy.desc: Graduates in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math degrees can work in the US for up to 36 months after graduation.

whyStudy.title: Curriculum Flexibility & Research Grants
whyStudy.desc: Freedom to customize your majors, change concentrations, and collaborate on multi-million dollar funded research labs.

Strong home ties documentation and genuine academic intent

faqs.q: Can international students work during studies in the USA?
faqs.a: Yes, international students on F-1 visas can work up to 20 hours per week on-campus during academic semesters and full-time (40 hours/week) during scheduled vacation breaks.

faqs.q: What is STEM OPT and who qualifies?
faqs.a: STEM OPT is an additional 24-month extension to the standard 12-month Optional Practical Training (total 36 months) for students graduating with designated Science, Tech, Engineering, or Math degrees.

faqs.q: Do US universities require GRE or GMAT?
faqs.a: Many universities have waived GRE/GMAT for 2025–2027 or made them optional. However, competitive programs still value high test scores for scholarship considerations.

faqs.q: Can I apply to UK universities without IELTS?
faqs.a: Yes, several UK institutions allow IELTS waivers if you scored 70%+ in High School English or can provide proof of instruction in English.

faqs.q: Does the UK allow dependents for students?
faqs.a: Under current UK immigration rules, only postgraduate research students (such as PhDs) can sponsor dependents on student visas.

faqs.q: What is the UK Graduate Route visa?
faqs.a: The Graduate Route allows international graduates who complete an undergraduate or master’s degree in the UK to stay and work for 2 years without employer sponsorship.

faqs.q: What is a Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL)?
faqs.a: The PAL is an official verification letter issued by the Canadian province to accompany student permit applications under the federal study cap guidelines.

faqs.q: Can I apply for PR after studying in Canada?
faqs.a: Yes! Canadian graduates who acquire 1 year of skilled work experience on their PGWP can apply through Express Entry’s Canadian Experience Class (CEC) or PNP programs.

faqs.q: What is the SDS stream for Canada?
faqs.a: Student Direct Stream (SDS) offers expedited study permit processing for applicants from select countries with a $20,635 CAD GIC and upfront tuition payment.

faqs.q: How many hours can I work in Australia as a student?

faqs.q: What is the Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate Visa?

faqs.q: What is an APS Certificate for Germany?
faqs.a: The Akademische Prüfstelle (APS) certificate verifies the authenticity of your academic documents and is a mandatory prerequisite for German student visa appointments.

faqs.q: What is an EU Blue Card in Germany?
faqs.a: An EU Blue Card is a work and residence permit for highly qualified professionals earning above a threshold salary, granting fast-track permanent residency in as little as 21–27 months.

faqs.q: What is a Critical Skills Employment Permit in Ireland?
faqs.a: It is a coveted work permit for tech, engineering, and medical professionals leading directly to Irish Permanent Residency (Stamp 4) in just 2 years.

faqs.q: Can students work part-time in Ireland?

faqs.q: Can students work part-time in Dubai/UAE?
faqs.a: Yes, international students holding a valid university-sponsored residence visa can work part-time (up to 20 hours/week) after obtaining a student work permit from the Ministry of Human Resources.

faqs.q: Is a degree from a Dubai branch campus the same as the main campus?
faqs.a: Yes! Institutions like University of Birmingham Dubai, Heriot-Watt, and UOWD award identical degree certificates conferred by their UK or Australian parent campuses.

faqs.q: How does the 10-Year UAE Golden Visa work for students?
faqs.a: Graduates with a cumulative GPA of 3.8+ from accredited UAE universities can apply for 10-year residency without employer sponsorship, permitting them to live and work anywhere in the country.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study abroad?
faqs.answer: Costs vary by country and university. Tuition can range from $0 (Germany public universities) to $50,000+ per year (USA Ivy League). Living costs add $8,000–$25,000/year. We help you find scholarships and education loans to reduce out-of-pocket expenses.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS or PTE to study abroad?
faqs.answer: Most English-speaking countries (UK, Canada, Australia, USA) require an English proficiency test like IELTS, TOEFL, or PTE. Some European countries (Germany, Ireland) may waive this for applicants with English-medium prior education. We guide you on the minimum scores required per university.

faqs.question: How does the student visa process work?
faqs.answer: After receiving an offer letter from your university, our visa team prepares your financial documents, Statement of Purpose, and application. We also conduct mock embassy interviews. Processing times range from 4 weeks (UK) to 12 weeks (USA), so we plan well in advance.

faqs.question: Are there scholarships available for international students?
faqs.answer: Yes! Many universities offer merit-based and need-based scholarships. Government scholarships such as Chevening (UK), Vanier (Canada), and Australia Awards are also available. We match your profile to the best scholarship opportunities and help with the application.

faqs.question: What are the main intakes for international students?
faqs.answer: Most universities offer two main intakes: September/Fall (largest intake) and January/Winter. Australia additionally has a July intake. We advise you on the best intake based on your academic calendar, preparation time, and application deadlines.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most countries allow part-time work during studies — Canada (20 hrs/week), UK (20 hrs/week), Australia (48 hrs/fortnight), and Germany (120 full days/year). Rules vary; we provide a full work-rights briefing for your destination country.

faqs.question: Can I get an education loan to study abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes. We partner with leading banks and NBFCs that offer education loans with competitive interest rates, covering tuition and living expenses. Some loans are collateral-free up to ₹40 lakhs. We assist with documentation and bank interviews.

faqs.question: How long does the entire process take?
faqs.answer: On average, the process takes 4–9 months from initial counselling to visa approval: 1–2 months for university selection, 2–4 months for application & admission, and 1–3 months for visa processing. Starting early gives you more choices and lower stress.

faqs.question: What is the overseas recruitment process?
faqs.answer: We register your profile, match you with suitable employers in the UAE, UK, Canada, or other destinations, and guide you through interviews, offer letters, and work-permit documentation. Our recruiters have placed 5,000+ candidates in healthcare, hospitality, construction, and IT roles.

faqs.question: Is there support after I arrive in my destination country?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our post-arrival support includes airport pickup coordination, local SIM registration, bank account setup guidance, and a dedicated helpline. We stay connected until you are fully settled in your new academic or work environment.

faqs.q: Is it better to stay on-campus or in private student accommodation?

faqs.q: Are utility bills (heating, electricity, internet) included in the rent?
faqs.a: Most purpose-built student accommodations (PBSA) include water, gas, electricity, heating, and high-speed Wi-Fi in the quoted weekly rent, helping students budget without surprise expenses.

faqs.q: Can I book my accommodation before receiving my student visa?

services.overview: Finding culturally adaptable, technically proficient, and background-verified talent for international deployment requires stringent vetting. Our multi-stage sourcing engine appraises candidates across technical competency, communication proficiency, and background integrity before presenting shortlists to clients.
deliverables: Multi-Tier Technical & Practical Skill Assessments
English & Foreign Language Communication Appraisals
Comprehensive Criminal History & Police Clearance Verifications
Previous Employer Performance Referencing & Credential Verification
Standardized Digital Candidate Dossiers with Video Interviews
Fast-Track 72-Hour Shortlist Delivery for Urgent Requisitions
Candidate Replacement Warranty within Probation Periods

process.title: Requisition Analysis
process.desc: We establish exact hiring criteria, technical prerequisites, salary bands, and workplace culture parameters with your HR team.

process.title: Targeted Headhunting
process.desc: We tap into our proprietary talent repository and industry networks across South Asia and the Middle East to identify high-caliber candidates.

process.title: Technical & Background Audits
process.desc: Candidates undergo practical assessments, language tests, and comprehensive background verification by our in-house compliance team.

process.title: Dossier Presentation
process.desc: Employers receive structured candidate profiles with test scores, verified portfolios, and video intros for interview scheduling.

faqs.q: How fast can YTC Global deliver a qualified candidate shortlist?
faqs.a: For standard technical, healthcare, and hospitality roles, we deliver pre-screened candidate dossiers within 72 hours of requisition sign-off.

faqs.q: Do you conduct trade tests for skilled technical labor?
faqs.a: Yes, we operate accredited technical testing centers for welding, electrical work, plumbing, CNC mechanics, and culinary trades.

faqs.q: What replacement policy do you offer employers?
faqs.a: We provide a 90-day replacement warranty. If a deployed candidate fails probation or voluntarily resigns, we provide a replacement at no added service fee.

services.title: Employer Partnerships
services.tagline: Strategic manpower supply, bulk workforce deployment, and long-term institutional staffing alliances.
services.overview: We partner with enterprise conglomerates, government healthcare trusts, hospitality chains, and infrastructure contractors as their strategic cross-border manpower ally. From managing thousands of candidates in bulk hiring drives to overseeing visa pipelines and travel logistics, we provide turnkey workforce scalability.
deliverables: Structured Master Service Agreements (MSA) with Clear SLA Benchmarks
Turnkey Bulk Recruitment Drives with In-Person or Virtual Client Booths
Bilateral Government Labor Clearance & Immigration Compliance Management
End-to-End Ticketing, Charter Logistics & Transit Coordination
Dedicated Key Account Manager & 24/7 Enterprise Support Dashboard
Workplace Health, Safety & Compliance Training Prior to Deployment
Ongoing Worker Welfare & Retention Management Programs

process.title: Partnership Design
process.desc: We tailor a Master Services Agreement (MSA) aligning with your corporate timelines, volume demands, compliance frameworks, and budget.

process.title: Hiring Campaign Rollout
process.desc: We execute multi-city recruitment campaigns, pre-screening thousands of applicants to stage client interview drives.

process.title: Logistics & Immigration
process.desc: Our enterprise operations wing manages medicals, work permit petitions, visa stamping, and flights in scheduled batches.

process.title: Deployment & Review
process.desc: We oversee on-site arrival, host post-deployment reviews, and maintain ongoing talent pipeline replenishment.

faqs.q: Can our hiring managers travel to conduct in-person interview drives?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We host full turnkey client interview drives in modern facilities, handling local hospitality, interview booths, and trade testing equipment.

faqs.q: How do you ensure compliance with local and international labor laws?
faqs.a: Our legal and compliance wing works in direct consultation with the Ministry of External Affairs and destination country labor authorities, ensuring zero legal exposure.

faqs.q: What is the maximum bulk recruitment capacity you can handle?
faqs.a: We regularly execute campaigns deploying between 50 to 500+ workers per hiring cycle for large infrastructure, hospitality, and healthcare initiatives.
